subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: Should provider-error abort/takeover recovery automatically carry prior transcript context into a replacement session, and what auth/channel/thread/clean-reset boundaries must block replay?
rationale: Current source has partial reset replay mechanics, but using them for takeover recovery changes the session privacy boundary and overlaps an open takeover PR plus a broader raw-tail continuity feature.

options.title: Approve bounded takeover replay
options.body: Allow a narrow replay of safe user/assistant tail context only when the replacement session has the same agent, auth profile, channel, thread, and session key, with regression tests for blocked boundary crossings.

options.title: Prefer original-session recovery
options.body: Avoid replacement-session context injection and instead make provider-error abort/takeover preserve the original session mapping or return resend guidance without rotating context.

options.title: Defer to raw-tail continuity design
options.body: Keep this issue open but make the broader last-N raw-message guarantee the design vehicle before changing takeover recovery.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded takeover replay
recommendation.body: Allow a narrow replay of safe user/assistant tail context only when the replacement session has the same agent, auth profile, channel, thread, and session key, with regression tests for blocked boundary crossings.
